about_the_game:
Monster Networking is a comedic little story game about overcoming social anxiety, making friends, and learning to navigate the professional world as someone who is anything but. 

You'll meet a wide cast of silly creatures along the journey through your first networking convention. Each of which host their own dungeon level you have to navigate through to get their business card! The gameplay of each of these sections is unique to the character you're talking to, meaning gameplay encounters ranging all the way from launching yourself in explosive platforming segments to backstabbing and sneaking your way through the dungeon to uncover a well guarded treasure.

short_description: Meet new monster friends, personal heroes, greedy evil businessmonsters, and more! Overcome social anxiety, collect business cards, connect with folks on Dunj-in, and try to become a professional in the weird world of the Dungeon Design Industry.
